about.intro: I am a Senior AI and Full-Stack Engineer with 20+ years designing, building, and operating production software. I focus on LLM-powered applications — document ingestion, hybrid retrieval, RAG, structured outputs, and tool-using agents — and I ship complete products, not only model prototypes.
about.story:
I started in 2005 as an independent web application developer in Nara, building database-driven systems for Japanese and international clients. That early work taught me to own the full path from requirements to a running product: interfaces, server logic, and data models.

At Sojin Co., Ltd. I worked as a frontend engineer, turning designs into production websites and commerce interfaces. At Kistem Co., Ltd. I moved to the backend, taking ownership of Rails services, relational data integrity, payment integrations, and production reliability.

In 2018 I joined BIX Tech Corp in Florida. I began as a senior full-stack and data systems engineer, then shifted into NLP and AI application work, and later into generative AI and RAG. Over those years I learned to put language models behind real products: ingestion pipelines, embeddings, hybrid search, evaluation, and the APIs and UIs that teams actually use.

Since November 2024 I have been a Senior LLM Systems & Full-Stack Engineer at Sakana AI in Tokyo. I design production LLM systems across retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation, security, and cloud infrastructure — with the same ownership I have always taken for software that has to run reliably beyond a demo.
